command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p out/e14
python3 - <<'IDENTITY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
roots={x:pathlib.Path(x) for x in ['agent','runtime','app','pinokio']}
ident={x:{'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'tree':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip(),'status':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()} for x,p in roots.items()}
ident['app_manifest_sha256']=hashlib.sha256((roots['app']/'public/install-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ident['runtime_lock_sha256']=hashlib.sha256((roots['agent']/'requirements/runtime.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ident['installed_product_digest']=None
ident['installed_product_note']='Editable source test environment; no installed-product digest claimed.'
pathlib.Path('out/e14/identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(ident,indent=2)+'\n')
IDENTITY
python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-venv"
V="$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-venv/bin/python"
"$V" -m pip install -e 'agent[dev]'
"$V" -m pip install --no-deps -e runtime -e runtime/packages/python
"$V" -c 'import runtime_protocol; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(runtime_protocol.__file__).resolve(); print("runtime_protocol",p); assert p.is_relative_to(Path("runtime").resolve())'
cd agent
set +e
"$V" -m pytest -o addopts= --collect-only -q tests/sdk/test_timeline_editing_acceptance_runtime.py tests/sdk/test_timeline_owned_move_publish.py > ../out/e14/collection.log 2>&1
collect=$?
"$V" -m pytest -o addopts= -vv -rA --junitxml=../out/e14/results.xml tests/sdk/test_timeline_editing_acceptance_runtime.py tests/sdk/test_timeline_owned_move_publish.py > ../out/e14/pytest.log 2>&1
test_exit=$?
set -e
export COLLECT_EXIT="$collect" TEST_EXIT="$test_exit"
python3 - <<'CHECK'

'test_e14_preview_does_not_reserve_a_key_and_keyed_replay_skips_evaluation', 'test_e14_create_with_picture_audio_content_and_fps_undoes_to_bootstrap', 'test_e14_unknown_commit_reopens_and_retries_the_exact_request', 'test_friendly_split_stages_native_command_for_function_commit', 'test_friendly_split_refuses_shot_owned_clips', 'test_parent_publish_captures_asset_clear_and_undoes_without_legacy_writer', 'test_parent_publish_captures_transition_clear_and_undoes_without_legacy_writer', 'test_parent_publish_restart_keeps_exact_request_key_and_rationale', 'test_unrelated_and_detached_publish_never_consume_global_pending_or_flight', 'test_mixed_and_unqueued_edits_are_held_without_consuming_draft', 'test_mixed_parent_delete_and_edit_are_held_without_writes', 'test_ambiguous_owner_and_occurrence_publish_refuse_with_draft_intact']

raise SystemExit(0 if data['collection_exit']==0 and data['pytest_exit']==0 and data['exact_inventory'] else 1)
